g_policy.reason: The offer copy says the reader 'also get[s] a voucher' but never says what the voucher is or how much it is worth, so the reward is not fully stated before the ad.

g_no_cash.reason: The 'adds' field and offer copy promise an undefined 'voucher' for watching another ad, and a voucher is listed as cash-like.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an article-open counter reaching 3 on s01, which is an app event and needs no chat or typed content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: Nothing free is removed or capped. Declining leaves the feed, articles, saving and sharing unchanged, and the reward only hides sponsored cards temporarily.

g_brand_safety.reason: The banner is app chrome, a card under the pill bar on s01, which is rated safe. It sits next to safe story content and is not in a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is a product_change. The new resource, an ad-light reading window, is tied to the observed core loop f01 (read a story) and the cards it hides are observed on s01 and s02.

c2_evidence.reason: The sponsored cards in the feed (s01.e44, s06.e33) and in articles (s02.e13) are observed, and the patchy fill is in the open questions and m01. The 'no paywall, limit, or currency' claim matches the model.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: No subscription was observed, and the reward is a time-limited 30-minute window capped at 2 per day.

c5_moment.reason: The offer appears when the reader returns to the feed after finishing an article, not mid-article. It is a dismissible banner.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The extra voucher is granted for watching one more ad after the game, which is a started or watched ad and not the verified play (REWARD_VERIFIED). The 30-minute window itself is tied to verified play.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names the Taboola native card below the first story on s01, the in-article card on s02, and the feed-to-article loop of this app.

other_concern: Trading away native-ad revenue for one game play is only plausible and rests on an assumption that the game earns more than the hidden cards. The proposal itself admits this. The flow also adds an extra voucher-ad screen that lengthens the experience.
